tei:div.tei:p: dhī/: rtsa gsum 'od gsal snying tig las: phag mo dkar mo shes rab gsal byed kyi rgyun khyer snying por dril ba bzhugs so: dhī/: na mo gu ru badzra wā ra hī pā dā ya/ rdo rje phag mo shes rab gsal byed kyi rgyun gyi rnal 'byor snying por dril ba ni/ bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkha' badzra sa mā dza:sa tshogs zhing mkha' khyab tu sad pa'i spyan sngar: na mo: phyogs dus rgyal ba rab 'byams kyi: ye shes chen po'i ngo bo nyid: bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor mar: mi phyed gus pas skyabs su mchi: lan gsum: ho: gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa'i 'gro ba rnams: 'od gsal rnam kun mchog ldan dbyings: 'pho 'gyur med par ro gcig phyir: rdo rje btsun mo bsgom par bgyi: zhes lan gsum gyis skyabs sems bya: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim par bsam: dngos gzhir lha bskyed pa ni: hrī: stong pa nyid dang snying rje che: zung 'jug bam̐ yig dkar po las: 'od 'phros snod bcud dbyings su sbyangs: tshur 'dus skad cig dran rdzogs su: rang rig bcom ldan wā ra hīḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar: phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug 'phyar: g.yon pas thod phrag thugs kar bsnams: mchan khung kha ṭwām̐ rtse gsum mtshan: spyi gtsug phag zhal ngur sgra sgrogs: dar dang rin chen rus pas brgyan: khro 'dzum chags nyams mtshan dper 'bar: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar stabs kyis: pad nyi bam ro'i snying gar rol: dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa: snang stong zung 'jug chen por gyur: ces brjod cing bsams la: dam ye gnyis med kyi lha sku'i gsal snang spyi dang bye brag la sems rtse gcig tu gzung : nga rgyal brtan por bsgrub: dag pa dran pa la bslab ste tha mal gyi snang zhen sbyang : des skyo na bzlas pa bya ba ni: thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor dbus: hrīṃ mthar sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor:

'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal kun mchod: khams gsum 'gro ba'i sgrib gnyis bsal: srid zhi'i shes rab ye shes bcud: bdud rtsi'i rnam par spyan drangs nas: lus ngag yid la thim pa yis: spobs pa'i gter mdzod grol bar gyur: ces bzlas dmigs gsal btab la: bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ bam̐ badzra wā ra hī pra dzñā dzñā na sarba siddhi hrīṃ dzaḥ zhes bzlas pa'i skyon spangs la rtse gcig tu bzla/ thun las ldang bar brtsam pa na: dbyangs gsal rten snying yi ge brgya pa rnams kyis sngags kyi lhag chad kha bskang zhing brtan par bya: a a a: zhes pas bskyed rim gyi snang cha 'od gsal gyi dbyings su thim par bsam la mnyam par bzhag: slar yang rang dang snang ba thams cad rje btsun rdo rje phag mo'i sku gsung thugs su gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brtan par bya: dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rdo rje phag mo 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog ces sogs bsngo smon shis brjod ji ltar rigs pas mtshams sbyar te spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang mtsho skyes bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs 'od gsal sprul pa'i rdo rjes so/ /sarba dā ka lya ṇaṃ bha ba tu//
